Definition: from G1364 and G5507; two thousand:--two thousand.
BiblicalUsage: Two thousand, the number of the swine that ran down the steep place into the sea when the demons left the man among the tombs.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that one delivered man was worth two thousand swine, and the people who counted the pigs missed the miracle standing in front of them.
